Distributed Data Structures

1. What are Distributed Data Structures?
  • Ignite provides cluster-wide data structures that behave like their single-JVM counterparts but are shared across all nodes;
  • They are built on top of Ignite's distributed cache infrastructure;
2. IgniteAtomicLong
  • A distributed, atomic long counter: 
    IgniteAtomicLong counter = ignite.atomicLong("myCounter", 0, true);

counter.incrementAndGet();  // 1
counter.addAndGet(10);      // 11
long value = counter.get(); // 11

counter.close(); // remove from cluster
  • Useful for generating distributed IDs, counting events, etc.;
3. IgniteAtomicReference
  • A distributed atomic reference to a single object: 
    IgniteAtomicReference<String> ref = ignite.atomicReference("myRef", "initial", true);

ref.set("updated");
String value = ref.get();

// Compare-and-set
boolean success = ref.compareAndSet("updated", "newValue");
4. IgniteQueue
  • A distributed, bounded or unbounded FIFO queue: 
    CollectionConfiguration colCfg = new CollectionConfiguration();
colCfg.setCacheMode(CacheMode.PARTITIONED);
colCfg.setBackups(1);

IgniteQueue<String> queue = ignite.queue("myQueue", 0, colCfg); // 0 = unbounded

queue.add("item1");
queue.add("item2");

String item = queue.poll(); // "item1"
int size = queue.size();    // 1
5. IgniteSet
  • A distributed set with unique elements: 
    CollectionConfiguration colCfg = new CollectionConfiguration();

IgniteSet<String> set = ignite.set("mySet", colCfg);

set.add("apple");
set.add("banana");
set.add("apple"); // duplicate, ignored

boolean contains = set.contains("apple"); // true
int size = set.size(); // 2
6. IgniteCountDownLatch & IgniteSemaphore
  • CountDownLatch — distributed synchronization barrier: 
    IgniteCountDownLatch latch = ignite.countDownLatch("myLatch", 3, false, true);

// On different nodes/threads:
latch.countDown();

// Wait until count reaches 0
latch.await();
  • Semaphore — distributed rate limiter: 
    IgniteSemaphore semaphore = ignite.semaphore("mySemaphore", 5, true, true);

semaphore.acquire();  // decrement permit count
// ... do work ...
semaphore.release();  // release permit
7. IgniteLock
  • A distributed reentrant lock: 
    IgniteLock lock = ignite.reentrantLock("myLock", true, true, true);

lock.lock();
try {
    // critical section — only one node/thread at a time
} finally {
    lock.unlock();
}
